'''Matthieu Paccou''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[December 2000 Montpellier tournament]] on 17 December 2000, according to Jean Philippe Thevier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1561">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-19-monpellier-france-17-12-2000d1561/ monpellier-france-17-12-2000], DeckTech (Jean Philippe "Warrior" Thevier, 19 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-19-monpellier-france-17-12-2000d1561/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
